core_result: No confirmed QM-GR unified dynamics was found. LP7 confirms an operational interface layer I[T] and an admission functional J_unify[I[T]].

nodes.label: J_unify is an admission functional over I[T], not a fundamental equation
Within LP7 enumerated candidate classes, no single class closes all six channels
T* is a layered interface architecture, not a confirmed unification theory
T* cannot be upgraded to the unified theory body because it lacks dynamical closure
LP7 closes at interface plus screening layer, not at confirmed unified dynamics
